panels.title: Quantidade de Alertas Críticos
panels.description: Eventos confirmados por cabine/tipo/fase. Regras provisórias: consulte REGRAS-DASHBOARDS.md.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
raw AS (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE 1=1 AND coletado_em >= FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) - INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND coletado_em <= LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))),
phases AS (SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'A' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_a='ok' THEN fase_a END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'B' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_b='ok' THEN fase_b END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'C' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_c='ok' THEN fase_c END valor FROM raw),
limits AS (
 SELECT *,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(coletado_em) ts,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 60 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.66 END ideal,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 70 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.759 END lim1,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 80 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.8580000000000001 END lim2,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 90 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.957 END lim3
 FROM phases
),
levels AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN valor IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN valor>=lim3 THEN 3 WHEN valor>=lim2 THEN 2 WHEN valor>=lim1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END severity,
 AVG(valor) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) baseline,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN valor END) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,fase ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) temp_recent,
 LAG(ts) OVER w prev_ts,LEAD(ts) OVER w next_ts,
 LEAD(valor) OVER w next_val,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts DESC,event_id DESC) rn
 FROM limits WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id)
),
flags AS (
 SELECT *,LAG(severity) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id) prev_severity,
 CASE WHEN next_val IS NOT NULL AND valor IS NOT NULL AND next_ts-ts<=5
 THEN GREATEST(0,LEAST(next_ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))-GREATEST(ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0)))) ELSE 0 END dt
 FROM levels
),
groups_ AS (
 SELECT *,SUM(CASE WHEN severity>0 AND (COALESCE(prev_severity,0)=0 OR ts-prev_ts>5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
 OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id) grp
 FROM flags
),
marked AS (
 SELECT *,MIN(CASE WHEN severity>0 THEN ts END) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp) event_start
 FROM groups_
),
event_groups AS (
 SELECT cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp,MIN(ts) first_ts,MAX(ts) last_ts,MAX(severity) severity,
 MAX(valor) peak,
 MIN(CASE WHEN ts-event_start>=10 OR (baseline>0 AND valor>=baseline*1.2 AND temp_recent>=70) THEN ts END) confirmed_ts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN severity=3 THEN dt ELSE 0 END) critical_seconds
 FROM marked WHERE severity>0 GROUP BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp
),
events AS (
 SELECT * FROM event_groups WHERE confirmed_ts IS NOT NULL AND last_ts>=UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
),
latest AS (SELECT * FROM levels WHERE rn=1 AND coletado_em>=FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
,
inventory AS (SELECT 'cabine-001' cabine_id UNION SELECT 'cabine-002' cabine_id UNION SELECT 'cabine-003' cabine_id UNION SELECT DISTINCT cabine_id FROM raw WHERE coletado_em>=FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0)),
counts AS (SELECT cabine_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(critical_seconds) critical_seconds,SUM(severity=3) critical_count FROM events GROUP BY cabine_id),
summary AS (
 SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE severity=3) alertas_criticos,
 (SELECT cabine_id FROM counts ORDER BY critical_seconds DESC,critical_count DESC,n DESC,cabine_id LIMIT 1) cabine_critica,
 (SELECT tipo FROM events GROUP BY tipo ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,SUM(critical_seconds) DESC,tipo LIMIT 1) tipo_problema,
 100.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counts)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory),0) pct_ocorrencias,
 100.0*COALESCE((SELECT SUM(n>=2) FROM counts),0)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory),0) pct_reincidencia,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw WHERE coletado_em>=FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0)) amostras
),
recent_events AS (SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY confirmed_ts DESC LIMIT 50)
SELECT s.*,
 CASE e.severity WHEN 3 THEN 'Crítico' WHEN 2 THEN 'Moderado' WHEN 1 THEN 'Atenção' END Nivel,
 CASE WHEN e.tipo='temperatura' THEN 'Temperatura' WHEN e.tipo='corrente' THEN 'Sobrecarga' END Alerta,
 e.cabine_id Cabine,e.fase Fase,e.peak Valor,
 CASE WHEN e.tipo='temperatura' THEN '°C' WHEN e.tipo='corrente' THEN 'A' END Unidade,
 FROM_UNIXTIME(e.confirmed_ts) Confirmado,
 FROM_UNIXTIME(e.last_ts) Ultima_leitura
FROM summary s LEFT JOIN recent_events e ON 1=1 ORDER BY e.confirmed_ts DESC
